transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a $5.8 million collateral delivery to our derivatives clearing broker due by Friday. The preliminary plan proposes delivering the full amount in cash. Before I authorize this, I need to hear from each of you — liquidity risk, legal, and collateral operations — on any issues or required controls. Let's start with liquidity risk. What's your assessment of delivering the full $5.8 million in cash?
